scope: Bounded existing-media revalidation against current movie lineage.
decision: Existing review media may be revalidated only by exact byte digest, explicit historical-only lineage retention, deterministic current lineage reconstruction, and a new human grounding review. A separate current-shot binding is required after review.
rationale: This preserves immutable historical evidence while preventing a historical candidate or review from being represented as produced from current lineage.
constraints: The evidence remains inert and grants no canon, publication, production, Runtime, provider, deployment, regeneration, ranking, recommendation, or autonomous workflow authority. The historical shot-binding contract remains unchanged.
